intro: The Samophlange Manual is a technical operating guide detailing the inner workings of the elusive samophlange. Kept under tight lock and key by the Venture Company, its scattered pages hold the instructions needed by goblin engineers to repair and operate the bizarre contraption.

p: Engineering schematics and operating handbooks are guarded like gold among goblin enterprises, and the Samophlange Manual is no exception. While working within the Venture Company, an ambitious overseer named Boss Copperplug jealously hoarded knowledge regarding the device, distributing only scattered pages to his most loyal subordinates to retain control over the machinery. When the device fell out of Venture Company clutches, repairing it proved impossible without assembling the torn, distributed documentation from the overseer and his crew at the Boulder Lode Mine.

After breaking ties with the Venture Company, the goblin engineer Rilli Greasygob took up residence in Orgrimmar with hopes of mastering the samophlange's construction. Lacking Copperplug's favor during his former employment, Rilli relies on enterprising travelers to retrieve the handbook's cover and loose leaves. Reconstructing the handbook offers goblin tinkerers working alongside the Horde a rare window into proprietary Venture Company engineering.
